# Icons

Icon names for `ui-icon` and the `icon` props of ui-kit components (needs `--icon-kit`). Write `pack:name` (`logistics:truck`) or a bare name, which is found in the first pack that has it: `core`, `arrows` and `status` first, then the industry packs alphabetically, `brands` last. Each pack: id (title, count): description, then its names.
